section.catchline: Accounting records for levies -- Records -- Report to Legislature, commission -- Budget to Division of Finance.
section.subsection: Each county shall separately budget and account for the use of any money the county receives or spends from a levy the county imposes in accordance with Section 59-2-1602.
The program manager shall separately budget and account for the use of any revenue received from the fund.

On or before October 1 of each year, the program manager shall submit an electronic report to the Revenue and Taxation Interim Committee and the commission that contains:a financial report that includes:the amount of revenue allocated to the program manager for the current calendar year; anda summary of the uses of the revenue during the current calendar year; anda status report on:the development, enhancement, and implementation of the statewide property tax system and the statewide web portals described in Section 59-2-1606; andachievement of the performance metrics described in Section 59-2-1606.
On or before December 31 of each year, the program manager shall submit a detailed budget for the upcoming calendar year to the Division of Finance.
For the calendar year that begins on January 1, 2026, the program manager shall submit a detailed budget for the current year to the Division of Finance on May 6, 2026.
